question: What was the name of the new department opened by Muhammad Tughlaq for the development of agriculture?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Diwan-i-Kohi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Diwan-i-Kohi** was established by Muhammad bin Tughlaq to focus on the development of agriculture and improve agrarian practices.
 
• This department was tasked with implementing innovative farming techniques and ensuring better irrigation facilities to enhance crop yields.
 
• Muhammad bin Tughlaq aimed to transform barren lands into fertile areas for agricultural purposes through state intervention.
 
• The initiative included providing financial assistance to farmers and infrastructure development such as canals and reservoirs.
 
• The establishment of Diwan-i-Kohi reflects Muhammad bin Tughlaq's ambitious plans for economic and agricultural reform during his reign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diwan-i-Wizarat:** This was the finance department of the Sultanate responsible for revenue collection and allocation.
 
• **Diwan-i-Qaza:** This department dealt with judicial matters and the administration of justice during the Sultanate period.
 
• **Diwan-i-Risalat:** It was responsible for managing correspondence and diplomatic affairs, particularly with foreign states.
 
• **Agricultural Reforms:** Muhammad bin Tughlaq introduced several measures, including tax relief and irrigation projects, to improve agricultural productivity.
 
• **Challenges:** Despite his visionary plans, many of Muhammad bin Tughlaq's initiatives, including agricultural reforms, faced implementation challenges due to poor administrative support and resistance from local populations.
